description:
A repository-owned primitive exposes the only code path for creating the two protected annotated tag namespaces.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One versioned interface accepts only candidate-tag or final-tag plus exact prepared/handoff identity, freeze SHA/root, compact payload, expected actor, environment, and repository; it constructs only the constant protected refs.
- [hard] REQ-02: The primitive mints one repository-only App token, creates the annotated ref without force, exact-readbacks the tag object and peeled SHA, returns structured completion fields, and always revokes without persisting credentials.
- [hard] REQ-03: Unit and negative fixtures reject arbitrary or movable refs, update/delete/force, GITHUB_TOKEN or PAT use, wrong identity/evidence, malformed payload, over-broad installation, persisted credentials, and cross-namespace use.
- [hard] REQ-04: The primitive owns no workflow trigger, job graph, transition schema, concurrency policy, hosted cross-workflow fixture, account setting, tag, release, or candidate byte.

## Notes

Blast radius: the fixed-ref interface, implementation, and unit/negative fixtures only.
title: Implement the fixed-ref tag authority primitive
